findings: Verified: README.md documents runtime > trusted project > global configuration precedence; config.test.ts distinguishes invalid-hint behavior (blocks fallback) from other invalid fields (fall through), and tests that untrusted project configuration is not read.
Verified: proposal-source.test.ts documents disclosure modes: omit removes tool calls/results and linked context replacements, while calls-only retains arguments but omits results/details.
Verified: auto-navigate-config.ts parseAutoNavigatePartial/mergeAutoNavigatePartial/materializeAutoNavigateConfig validate fields and ranges and merge per-tool disclosure policy.

Verified: proposal-command.ts sends full textual history across branches for model proposals. Potential disclosure risk: the breadth of transmitted history may include material beyond the immediate proposal context.

Verified: proposal-source.ts and docs/retrospective-cloning.md describe full textual history by default and structured tool filtering; excluded tool records do not remove sensitive copies in prose or historical summaries, a potential disclosure risk.
Verified: continuity-briefing.ts renderBriefing preserves objectives/goals/rules/decisions even when over budget, while dropping facts/files/steering with an omission note.

Verified: config.ts parses trusted layered configuration and strictly validates proposal disclosure; invalid proposal configuration blocks proposals. continuity-ledger.ts parseLedger/parseDelta validate schemas and lineage; retrospective.ts binds previews to source hashes and rechecks source bytes before publishing.
Verified: index.ts continuityRequestSection includes folded-span user references in summary requests. Potential sensitivity risk: captured verbatim user content may be propagated into summaries.
